To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the binding of GMP-PNP, but not of GDP, to smg p25 A was inhibited by Mg2+ or NaCl.

the dissociation and binding of GTP and GTP gamma S are the rate-limiting steps in the GDP-GTP and GDP-GTP gamma S interconversions of smg p25, respectively, and that the GDP dissociation step is accelerated by an endogenous protein in brain cytosol.

the binding of guanosine triphosphate (GTP) to smg p25, a guanosine triophosphate-binding protein, was stimulated in vitro by an endogenous stimulator protein, and the stimulator protein was present in bovine brain and was not present in bovine liver.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the kinetic analysis of the binding and hydrolysis of guanine nucleotides to smg p25 A.
the kinetic mechanism of the binding of the guanine nucleotide, GDP, to smg p25.
the kinetic analysis of the binding and the dissociation reactions of GDP and GTP to smg p25 A, a guanine-nucleotide-binding protein with Mr of about 25000.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the binding of GMP-PNP to smg p25 A is not inhibited by the presence of Mg2+ or NaCl, and that the dissociation rate of GDP from smgd25A is accelerated by the presence of these salts.
GDP is dissociated from smg p21A by a protein, and that GTP is bound to smg p25 A by a protein.
the binding of GMP-P(NH)P, GTP gamma S and GDP to smg p25a is regulated by Mg2+ and NaCl.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
GDP dissociation inhibitor (GDI) is a protein which inhibits dissociation of GDP and stimulates the dissociation of GTP from smg p21A.
the binding of GDP to smg p25 A is regulated by the protein stimulating the GDP dissociation from this protein and the protein stimulating the GTP binding to this protein.

the GDP-GTP exchange of smg p25As in mammalian tissues is controlled by a GDP dissociation stimulatory factor and a GTPase activating protein, and that the former is present in mammalian tissues and the latter is absent in these tissues.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the dissociation constant for GTP binding to the GDP-bound form of smg p25 is 1.5 microM, whereas that of GDP binding to the GTP-bound form is 2.3 microM.
smg p25 is a guanine nucleotides binding protein that can be activated by a GEF.

the dissociation rate of GDP from smgp25A is accelerated by the presence of the stimulator protein in the brain cytosol, and the dissociated GDP is replaced by GTP, which leads to activation of the GTP-bound smgp25A.
